- The disposable SQL proof runner (scripts/ovd510-disposable-replay.mjs) may need `git fetch --unshallow` / specific commits and docker images tagged under public.ecr.aws names: pull the same tag from Docker Hub (`docker pull supabase/<name>:<tag>`) and `docker tag` it to the public.ecr.aws name it expects. The repo clone may be shallow: check `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository`.

## Sandboxed Chromium on #564-based branches
Branches based on codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003 (#564) set `chromiumSandbox: true` in playwright.config.ts. Chromium's sandbox refuses to run as root here, so run Playwright as the non-root user `ubuntu` (uid 1000; user namespaces are enabled):
  `chown -R ubuntu:ubuntu "$PWD"` is NOT allowed (shared node_modules symlinks point at /home/user/Overdrafter). Instead:
  `mkdir -p test-results playwright-report && chown ubuntu:ubuntu test-results playwright-report && chmod -R a+rX "$PWD"` then
  `flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock runuser -u ubuntu -- env HOME=/tmp/ubuntu-home PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npx playwright test ...`
  (create /tmp/ubuntu-home owned by ubuntu first). If Vite needs to write node_modules/.vite, set `VITE_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/ubuntu-vite-<unit>` or give that dir to ubuntu. Do not edit the config to disable the sandbox.
  If running as ubuntu is impossible for a case, record it in not_verified_here and rely on hosted CI rather than weakening the config.
